name: resend_delayed_delivery_notifications

steps.title: Find delayed shipments
steps.command: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U harborline -d harborline -Atc "SELECT shipment_id, promised_at, status FROM shipments WHERE shipment_id IN ('SHP-10482','SHP-10493','SHP-10507') ORDER BY shipment_id;"
steps.verify_command: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U harborline -d harborline -Atc "SELECT shipment_id, status FROM shipments WHERE shipment_id IN ('SHP-10482','SHP-10493','SHP-10507') ORDER BY shipment_id;"

steps.title: Check existing notification deliveries
steps.command: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U harborline -d harborline -Atc "SELECT shipment_id, COUNT(*) FROM notification_deliveries WHERE notification_type = 'delayed_delivery' AND shipment_id IN ('SHP-10482','SHP-10493','SHP-10507') GROUP BY shipment_id ORDER BY shipment_id;"
steps.verify_command: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U harborline -d harborline -Atc "SELECT shipment_id, COUNT(*) FROM notification_deliveries WHERE notification_type = 'delayed_delivery' AND shipment_id IN ('SHP-10482','SHP-10493','SHP-10507') GROUP BY shipment_id ORDER BY shipment_id;"

steps.title: Send second delayed notification

steps.title: Send third delayed notification

steps.verify_command: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U harborline -d harborline -Atc "SELECT delivery_id, shipment_id, channel, created_at FROM notification_deliveries WHERE shipment_id = 'SHP-10507' AND notification_type = 'delayed_delivery' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;"

steps.title: Confirm notification queue health

steps.title: Verify all notification deliveries

steps.verify_command: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U harborline -d harborline -Atc "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification_deliveries WHERE notification_type = 'delayed_delivery' AND shipment_id IN ('SHP-10482','SHP-10493','SHP-10507') AND created_at >= '2026-04-09T12:00:00Z';"

name: reprocess_edifact_214_dead_letters_20250308
goal: Replay a bounded batch of dead-lettered EDI 214 tracking messages into the tracking pipeline, confirm consumption, and close the incident with an audit trail.

steps.title: Measure Dead-Letter Queue Offsets
steps.command: docker exec harborline-kafka kafka-run-class kafka.tools.GetOffsetShell --broker-list harborline-kafka:9092 --topic hl.tracking.edifact214.dlq --time -1
steps.verify_command: docker exec harborline-kafka kafka-run-class kafka.tools.GetOffsetShell --broker-list harborline-kafka:9092 --topic hl.tracking.edifact214.dlq --time -1

steps.title: Select Bounded Dead-Letter Batch
steps.command: docker exec harborline-postgres psql -U harborline -d tracking -P pager=off -c "SELECT message_id, edi_control_number, received_at FROM edifact_214_dead_letters WHERE incident_id = 'INC-214-20250308' AND replay_state = 'pending' ORDER BY received_at LIMIT 500;"
steps.output: 500 rows selected; message_id range MSG-214-88410 through MSG-214-88909
steps.verify_command: docker exec harborline-postgres psql -U harborline -d tracking -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM edifact_214_dead_letters WHERE incident_id = 'INC-214-20250308' AND replay_state = 'pending';"

steps.title: Publish Batch To Replay Topic
steps.command: printf 'MSG-214-88410|21400088410|MSG-214-88909\n' | docker exec -i harborline-kafka kafka-console-producer --broker-list harborline-kafka:9092 --topic hl.tracking.edifact214.replay --property parse.key=true --property key.separator=:
steps.output: 1 replay envelope published for 500 selected messages
steps.verify_command: docker exec harborline-kafka kafka-run-class kafka.tools.GetOffsetShell --broker-list harborline-kafka:9092 --topic hl.tracking.edifact214.replay --time -1

steps.title: Submit Replay To Carrier Gateway
steps.command: curl --fail-with-body -sS -X POST https://carrier-gateway.harborline.example/internal/v1/edi214/replay -H 'X-Harborline-Incident: INC-214-20250308' -H 'Idempotency-Key: absent-for-dlq-replay' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"source_topic":"hl.tracking.edifact214.dlq","batch_start":"MSG-214-88410","batch_end":"MSG-214-88909","limit":500}'
steps.verify_command: curl --fail-with-body -sS https://carrier-gateway.harborline.example/internal/v1/edi214/replay/RPL-20250308-00417

steps.title: Check Replay Consumer Progress
steps.command: docker exec harborline-kafka kafka-consumer-groups.sh --bootstrap-server harborline-kafka:9092 --describe --group tracking-ingest-214-replay
steps.verify_command: docker exec harborline-kafka kafka-consumer-groups.sh --bootstrap-server harborline-kafka:9092 --describe --group tracking-ingest-214-replay | grep 'hl.tracking.edifact214.replay'

steps.title: Mark Replay Rows Processed
steps.command: docker exec harborline-postgres psql -U harborline -d tracking -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "UPDATE edifact_214_dead_letters SET replay_state = 'replayed', replay_id = 'RPL-20250308-00417', replayed_at = now() WHERE incident_id = 'INC-214-20250308' AND message_id BETWEEN 'MSG-214-88410' AND 'MSG-214-88909' AND replay_state = 'pending';"
steps.verify_command: docker exec harborline-postgres psql -U harborline -d tracking -Atc "SELECT replay_state, count(*) FROM edifact_214_dead_letters WHERE incident_id = 'INC-214-20250308' GROUP BY replay_state ORDER BY replay_state;"

steps.title: Post Replay Completion Notice
steps.command: curl --fail-with-body -sS -X POST https://hooks.slack.com/services/T04HL/B08HL/Q7inc214Replay20250308 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"text":"EDI 214 dead-letter replay RPL-20250308-00417 completed for 500 messages; tracking-ingest consumer lag is zero."}'
steps.verify_command: docker exec harborline-postgres psql -U harborline -d tracking -Atc "SELECT replay_id, replay_state FROM edifact_214_dead_letters WHERE replay_id = 'RPL-20250308-00417' LIMIT 1;"

steps.title: Confirm No Pending Incident Messages
steps.command: docker exec harborline-postgres psql -U harborline -d tracking -P pager=off -c "SELECT count(*) AS pending_messages FROM edifact_214_dead_letters WHERE incident_id = 'INC-214-20250308' AND replay_state <> 'replayed';"
steps.verify_command: docker exec harborline-postgres psql -U harborline -d tracking -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM edifact_214_dead_letters WHERE incident_id = 'INC-214-20250308' AND replay_state = 'replayed';"

name: fedex_adapter_cutover
goal: Cut production FedEx shipment traffic from the legacy adapter to the new adapter and verify the new route is healthy.

steps.title: Check legacy adapter health
steps.command: kubectl -n harborline-prod get deployment fedex-legacy-adapter -o jsonpath='{.status.readyReplicas}/{.status.replicas}{"\n"}'
steps.verify_command: kubectl -n harborline-prod get pods -l app=fedex-legacy-adapter -o wide

steps.title: Validate new adapter configuration
steps.command: jq -e '.carriers.fedex.adapter == "fedex-adapter-v2" and .carriers.fedex.timeout_ms == 5000' harborline/config/carriers.json
steps.verify_command: jq '.carriers.fedex' harborline/config/carriers.json

steps.title: Enqueue in-flight shipment retries
steps.command: psql -d harborline -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "INSERT INTO shipment_retry_jobs (shipment_id, carrier, adapter, requested_at) SELECT shipment_id, 'FEDEX', 'fedex-adapter-v2', now() FROM shipments WHERE carrier = 'FEDEX' AND status IN ('PENDING','RETRY') AND shipment_id BETWEEN 'SHP-100042' AND 'SHP-100219';"
steps.verify_command: psql -d harborline -c "SELECT count(*) FROM shipment_retry_jobs WHERE carrier = 'FEDEX' AND adapter = 'fedex-adapter-v2' AND requested_at > now() - interval '15 minutes';"

steps.title: Switch FedEx route configuration
steps.command: kubectl -n harborline-prod patch configmap carrier-routing --type=merge -p '{"data":{"fedex-adapter":"fedex-adapter-v2"}}'
steps.verify_command: kubectl -n harborline-prod get configmap carrier-routing -o jsonpath='{.data.fedex-adapter}{"\n"}'

steps.title: Notify operations of cutover
steps.command: curl -fsS -X POST https://hooks.slack.com/services/T04HL/B07HL/CUTOVER123 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"channel":"#hl-carrier-ops","text":"FedEx production traffic cut over to fedex-adapter-v2; retry jobs SHP-100042 through SHP-100219 were enqueued."}'
steps.verify_command: kubectl -n harborline-prod logs deployment/notification-service --since=10m | grep -F 'FedEx production traffic cut over to fedex-adapter-v2' | tail -1

steps.title: Record cutover audit event
steps.command: psql -d harborline -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "INSERT INTO deployment_audit_log (deployment_name, environment, actor, metadata) VALUES ('fedex-adapter-v2', 'production', '@maya.chen', '{\"route\":\"fedex-adapter-v2\",\"window\":\"SHP-100042-SHP-100219\"}');"
steps.verify_command: psql -d harborline -c "SELECT actor, metadata->>'route' FROM deployment_audit_log WHERE deployment_name = 'fedex-adapter-v2' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;"

steps.title: Scale down legacy adapter
steps.command: kubectl -n harborline-prod scale deployment/fedex-legacy-adapter --replicas=0
steps.verify_command: kubectl -n harborline-prod get deployment fedex-legacy-adapter -o jsonpath='{.spec.replicas}{"\n"}'

steps.title: Verify FedEx traffic health
steps.command: curl -fsS https://tracking.harborline.com/internal/health/carriers/fedex | jq -e '.adapter == "fedex-adapter-v2" and .status == "healthy" and .error_rate < 0.01'
steps.verify_command: curl -fsS https://tracking.harborline.com/internal/metrics/carriers/fedex | grep -E 'fedex_requests_total|rate_errors' | tail -2

name: credit_q2_sla_misses
goal: Credit accounts for Q2 SLA misses, issue notifications, and reconcile the resulting financial records.

steps.title: Inspect Q2 SLA Breaches
steps.command: psql "$DATABASE_URL" -c "SELECT breach_id, shipment_id, customer_id, missed_at, credit_cents FROM sla_breaches WHERE missed_at >= '2024-04-01' AND missed_at < '2024-07-01' AND status = 'open' ORDER BY breach_id;"
steps.output: 12 breach records returned for customers acme and northstar.
steps.verify_command: psql "$DATABASE_URL" -c "SELECT count(*) AS open_breaches FROM sla_breaches WHERE missed_at >= '2024-04-01' AND missed_at < '2024-07-01' AND status = 'open';"

steps.title: Preview Customer Credit Totals
steps.command: psql "$DATABASE_URL" -c "SELECT customer_id, sum(credit_cents) AS total_credit_cents FROM sla_breaches WHERE missed_at >= '2024-04-01' AND missed_at < '2024-07-01' AND status = 'open' GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY customer_id;"
steps.verify_command: psql "$DATABASE_URL" -c "SELECT customer_id, coalesce(sum(credit_cents),0) AS pending_credit_cents FROM sla_breaches WHERE missed_at >= '2024-04-01' AND missed_at < '2024-07-01' AND status = 'open' GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY customer_id;"

steps.title: Apply SLA Credit Ledger
steps.command: psql "$DATABASE_URL" -c "INSERT INTO customer_credit_ledger (ledger_id, customer_id, breach_id, credit_cents, reason, created_at) SELECT 'ledger-q2-' || breach_id, customer_id, breach_id, credit_cents, 'Q2 SLA miss', now() FROM sla_breaches WHERE missed_at >= '2024-04-01' AND missed_at < '2024-07-01' AND status = 'open';"
steps.verify_command: psql "$DATABASE_URL" -c "SELECT customer_id, count(*) AS ledger_entries, sum(credit_cents) AS credited_cents FROM customer_credit_ledger WHERE reason = 'Q2 SLA miss' GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY customer_id;"

steps.title: Update Breach Credit Status
steps.command: psql "$DATABASE_URL" -c "UPDATE sla_breaches SET status = 'credited', credited_at = now() WHERE missed_at >= '2024-04-01' AND missed_at < '2024-07-01' AND status = 'open';"
steps.verify_command: psql "$DATABASE_URL" -c "SELECT count(*) AS credited_breaches FROM sla_breaches WHERE missed_at >= '2024-04-01' AND missed_at < '2024-07-01' AND status = 'credited';"

steps.title: Queue Customer Credit Notices
steps.command: curl -fsS -X POST http://localhost:8080/internal/jobs/credit-notices -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"job_id":"credit-notices-q2-2024","customer_ids":["acme","northstar"],"ledger_reason":"Q2 SLA miss"}'
steps.verify_command: psql "$DATABASE_URL" -c "SELECT job_id, status, created_at FROM background_jobs WHERE job_id = 'credit-notices-q2-2024';"

name: refund_duplicate_expedite_fees
goal: Issue and reconcile refunds for the identified duplicate expedite fees on shipment SHP-104892 without changing unrelated charges.

steps.title: Identify Duplicate Expedite Fees
steps.command: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U harborline -d billing -c "SELECT fee_id, shipment_id, amount_cents, stripe_payment_intent_id, duplicate_of_fee_id FROM expedite_fees WHERE shipment_id='SHP-104892' AND duplicate_of_fee_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY created_at;"
steps.output:
fee_id            | amount_cents | stripe_payment_intent_id | duplicate_of_fee_id
 fee_exp_8841      | 3500         | pi_3Pship104892A         | fee_exp_8702
 fee_exp_8842      | 3500         | pi_3Pship104892B         | fee_exp_8702
steps.verify_command: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U harborline -d billing -c "SELECT count(*) FROM expedite_fees WHERE shipment_id='SHP-104892' AND duplicate_of_fee_id IS NOT NULL;"

steps.title: Export Refund Candidate Rows
steps.command: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U harborline -d billing -At -F ',' -c "SELECT fee_id, stripe_payment_intent_id, amount_cents FROM expedite_fees WHERE shipment_id='SHP-104892' AND fee_id IN ('fee_exp_8841','fee_exp_8842') ORDER BY fee_id;" > /tmp/SHP-104892-refunds.csv && cat /tmp/SHP-104892-refunds.csv
steps.verify_command: test "$(wc -l < /tmp/SHP-104892-refunds.csv)" -eq 2 && cat /tmp/SHP-104892-refunds.csv

steps.title: Append Refund Ledger Entries
steps.command: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U harborline -d billing -c "INSERT INTO refund_ledger (fee_id, payment_intent_id, amount_cents, reason, ticket) SELECT fee_id, stripe_payment_intent_id, amount_cents, 'duplicate_expedite_fee', 'HL-2487' FROM expedite_fees WHERE fee_id IN ('fee_exp_8841','fee_exp_8842');"
steps.verify_command: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U harborline -d billing -c "SELECT fee_id, count(*) FROM refund_ledger WHERE ticket='HL-2487' GROUP BY fee_id ORDER BY fee_id;"

steps.title: Issue Stripe Refunds
steps.command: curl -sS -X POST -u "$STRIPE_SECRET_KEY:" -d payment_intent=pi_3Pship104892A -d amount=3500 -d reason=requested_by_customer https://api.stripe.com/v1/refunds && curl -sS -X POST -u "$STRIPE_SECRET_KEY:" -d payment_intent=pi_3Pship104892B -d amount=3500 -d reason=requested_by_customer https://api.stripe.com/v1/refunds
steps.verify_command: curl -sS -u "$STRIPE_SECRET_KEY:" 'https://api.stripe.com/v1/refunds?payment_intent=pi_3Pship104892A'

steps.title: Mark Duplicate Fees Refunded
steps.command: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U harborline -d billing -c "UPDATE expedite_fees SET refund_status='refunded', refunded_at=now(), refund_ticket='HL-2487' WHERE fee_id IN ('fee_exp_8841','fee_exp_8842') AND refund_status='pending';"
steps.verify_command: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U harborline -d billing -c "SELECT fee_id, refund_status FROM expedite_fees WHERE fee_id IN ('fee_exp_8841','fee_exp_8842') ORDER BY fee_id;"

steps.title: Notify Billing Operations Channel
steps.command: docker compose exec -T slack-cli slack-cli post --channel '#hl-billing-ops' --text 'HL-2487: duplicate expedite refunds completed for SHP-104892; fee IDs fee_exp_8841 and fee_exp_8842; total $70.00 USD.'
steps.verify_command: docker compose exec -T slack-cli slack-cli history --channel '#hl-billing-ops' --limit 20 | grep 'HL-2487' | tail -n 5

steps.title: Reconcile Refund Totals
steps.command: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U harborline -d billing -c "SELECT sum(amount_cents) AS ledger_total_cents, count(*) AS ledger_rows FROM refund_ledger WHERE ticket='HL-2487' AND fee_id IN ('fee_exp_8841','fee_exp_8842');"
steps.verify_command: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U harborline -d billing -c "SELECT count(*) FROM refund_ledger WHERE ticket='HL-2487' AND amount_cents=3500;"

steps.title: Close Refund Operations Ticket
steps.command: curl -sS -X PATCH -H 'Authorization: Bearer harborline-ops' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 'https://ops.harborline.internal/api/tickets/HL-2487' -d '{"status":"resolved","resolution":"duplicate expedite fees refunded and reconciled"}'
steps.verify_command: curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer harborline-ops' 'https://ops.harborline.internal/api/tickets/HL-2487' | grep '"status":"resolved"'
